variant_note: Polish K239PL: Korean K239 Chunmoo launcher module (2 pods) on the Polish Jelcz P882.57 (TS T45 K-MLRS) 8×8 chassis with Polish Topaz fire control. Not the Korean K239L chassis. Prototypes at MSPO 2023 also showed a third-generation Jelcz P883.57 chassis.
country_of_origin: South Korea / Poland (Hanwha launcher, Jelcz chassis)

armament.main: 2 × launch pod; per pod 6 × 239 mm CGR-080 guided rockets (80 km) or 1 × 600 mm CTM-290 tactical ballistic missile (290 km)

protection: Armoured 3-seat cab (small arms and shell fragments); launcher module unarmoured
notes: Poland ordered 290 launchers (executive contracts for 218 in Nov 2022 and 72 in Apr 2024); deliveries from 2023, first to the 18th Artillery Regiment in Nowa Dęba.
silhouette_features: Long, low launcher deck with two box-shaped launch pods side by side behind the cab
Pod frames fully retract under a flat top cover when stowed (no visible rails, unlike M270)
Armoured three-seat forward-control cab of the Jelcz 882 family
